title: Evoluon (Polygoon, Weeknummer 68-34) / The Evoluon, Philips' science pavilion
license: CC-BY-SA 3.0 NL (Open Beelden / Beeld en Geluid; Polygoon-Profilti producent)
notes: Netherlands, Dutch: Polygoon-Profilti newsreel, Eindhoven 1968 — the Evoluon: the flying-saucer building and its tower, then the long window, a circuit of the interior: the ramps and the dome, visitors at the exhibits, the moving model of a uranium atom as points of light in the dark, a dial, a washing-machine drum; boys wiring electronics kits and a meter, a model boat, a picture-phone with a boy on its screen, a television camera, and the tower on a monitor. Source MP4 (360×288) from openbeelden.nl, uncropped.
